mapper.insert: INSERT INTO page (book_id, page_no, type, ori_text, annotation, md_content, pdf_ocr_ori_content, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{pageNo}, #{type}, #{oriText}, #{annotation}, #{mdContent}, #{pdfOcrOriContent}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id AS bookId, page_no AS pageNo, type, ori_text AS oriText, annotation, md_content AS mdContent, pdf_ocr_ori_content AS pdfOcrOriContent, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM page WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY page_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE page SET type = #{type}, ori_text = #{oriText}, annotation = #{annotation}, pdf_ocr_ori_content = #{pdfOcrOriContent}, update_time = NOW() WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND page_no = #{pageNo}
